sloka: तस्मिन्नस्तमिते चाथ मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रकोविदैः ।पित्र्ये पदे कृतो वाली सुग्रीवो वालिनः पदे ।। ७.३६.३९ ॥
transliteration: tasminnastamite cātha mantribhirmantrakovidaiḥ ।pitrye pade kṛto vālī sugrīvo vālinaḥ pade ।। 7.36.39 ॥

translations.english: After Ṛkṣarajas passed away, the wise ministers then placed Vali in his father's position, and Sugriva in Vali's position.
